evidence.source: Academia Sinica Institute of Information Science, Chinese Character Database
evidence.text: The 山 record labels the graph pictographic and describes it as depicting mountain peaks standing together. It lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, small-seal and Shuowen forms; its bronze references include 集成05396 and 金文詁林索引9.245. The accessible record does not date each specimen or establish a continuous sequence of changes.
evidence.title: 漢字「山」：字形演變

evidence.text: The file page identifies 山-seal.svg as a modern vector depiction of 山 in Shuowen seal-script style and attributes its source material to the Sinica Database and other listed references. It is a modern digital drawing, not an artifact photograph. The description states CC0 1.0; it separately notes the Sinica source picture is CC0.

search_audit.query: 山 字形演變 甲骨文 金文 小篆 Academia Sinica 小學堂
search_audit.outcome: Search located and the Sinica character-specific paleographic page was opened. Its text supports pictographic formation and named script-stage categories, but it gives no specimen dates.

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons File 山-seal.svg Shuowen Seal Radical 350 山
search_audit.outcome: Opened the exact Commons file page, verified its modern vector description, CC0 rights statement, and original file link. Direct SVG fetch failed because the web tool does not support its content type.

search_audit.query: 山 甲骨文 合集5431 文字 考釋
search_audit.outcome: No third query was issued: the inspected primary specialist graph-history page supports the formation account, and the dossier already records the outstanding earliest lexical-attestation gap.

gaps: No independent dated specimen or deciphered inscription context was obtained for the earliest 山 attestation; the paleographic record's cited bronze reference is not itself an independently inspected artifact reading.

The record lists script stages but does not establish precise dates for each specimen or a continuous stroke-by-stroke derivation. The seal-script image is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph.
The direct original SVG URL was verified from the Commons description page but could not be rendered by the web tool; no claim of visual inspection is made.

No component analysis is applicable: the supported account treats 山 as a pictograph without semantic/phonetic subcomponents. No graph borrowing or sequence of semantic extensions was established in this bounded verification. The supplied early literary and local pronunciation evidence was not independently rechecked here. The required official Unicode Unihan page was not inspected in this run.

items.period: Seal-script tradition; the file depicts a Shuowen seal-style form, without a specimen date
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 山 in Shuowen seal-script style, illustrating a later stylized form in the character's graphic history.
items.alt: A seal-script form of 山, drawn as a stylized set of rising peaks.
items.selection_reason: The Sinica graph-history record identifies 山 as a pictograph of mountain peaks and includes a small-seal stage; this file page provides an exact, reusable modern illustration of that stage.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The image is a modern digital vector drawing, not a photograph or scan of an ancient inscription; the direct SVG was not visually rendered in this research.
The paleographic record lists oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, seal and Shuowen categories but supplies no specimen-by-specimen dates in its accessible text.
